info.title: Opmux Usage and Allowance API — Proposed Contract
info.description: DESIGN ONLY, not shipped endpoints. Tenant-scoped management API plus additive inference attribution. See api-contract.md and admin-ui-contract.md. Monetary values are configured-tariff estimates, not invoices.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required in enforce mode; optional in observe mode. Duplicate suppression, not generated-content replay. Reuse of a committed key returns 409 and the original usage ID.

X-Opmux-Usage-Request-ID.description: Durable usage identity when an operation was admitted, including duplicate suppression responses.

409.description: Duplicate generation or conflicting idempotency key. No generated answer is cached.

X-Opmux-Usage-Request-ID.description: Durable usage identity when an operation was admitted, including duplicate suppression responses.

429.description: ALLOWANCE_EXCEEDED or existing overload/provider-throttling code; dispatch did not begin for a denied attempt.

X-Opmux-Usage-Request-ID.description: Durable usage identity when an operation was admitted, including duplicate suppression responses.

post.description: PROPOSED extension of the shipped ingress contract. Inference key only; management keys are forbidden. Enforce requires registered customer attribution and Idempotency-Key. Stream/rewrite remain rejected. No policy/client_id/price fields are accepted.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Management for /api/v1/usage/*; inference for /api/v1/route. Never a browser-stored credential.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique logical mutation key. Replay window: management 7 days; inference suppression 90 days. Preserve key and original preconditions on ambiguous transport retries.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exact strong ETag from the corresponding resource GET. Wildcards and multiple tags are not accepted.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque, signed, tenant/filter-bound cursor. Expires after 15 minutes.

To.name: to
To.description: Exclusive end; later than from and at most 31 days after it.

Error.description: Sanitized existing envelope. See api-contract.md for status/code semantics.

Retry-After.description: Optional bounded advice for transient busy/pending states; never an automatic retry instruction for exhausted allowance.

X-Opmux-Usage-Request-ID.description: Present if a durable usage operation exists.

OpaqueLabel.description: Tenant-local opaque identifier. Do not send email addresses, secrets, or personal data.

Usd.description: Nonnegative configured-tariff USD estimate or allowance, exactly nine decimal places. Never a provider invoice.

SignedUsd.description: Exact signed USD capacity adjustment; not a change to usage cost.

Count.description: Exact nonnegative integer encoded as a string.

Reason.description: Human-readable audit reason; no secrets or prompt text. Whitespace-only values are rejected.

Balance.description: Current period balance, not dispatch authorization. active_hold and pending_exposure cover current-period bounded holds; carryover includes all older bounded holds. total_held is their sum. available/overcommitted are null without a policy or with unbounded unknowns. complete is false if usage is still uncertain.

CostTotals.description: Known/bounded components only; unknown costs are not zero. Period queries use attempt admission time. Counts across groups are not necessarily additive for requests spanning targets.

GenerationRequest.description: Proposed additive ingress extension. Existing configured prompt/body/token limits also apply. Metadata is opaque and is never persisted. stream/rewrite remain unsupported.

cost.description: Existing eight-decimal successful-response estimate; not total request ledger cost.

UsageRequest.description: One generation operation. No prompt or generated content. Execution can succeed while accounting remains pending.
